scenario: [LNUL.5.1] with [LNUL.5.4]: the twin of LNUL.5.1_has_on_unnarrowed_json_refused. `d.body is not null and has(d.body.x)` narrows the `Json?` root in the tail of the `where` conjunction, so `has`'s argument has a present root and the program compiles. Together the pair shows the refusal is the root's nullability: a compiler that refused every `has` on a `Json?` slot fails this one, and one that refused none fails the other. PATH PINNED: `dsc.typecheck`'s `lnul_5_1_builtin_arguments` reading the narrowed set (`narrowed_here`).
